mainEntity.name: What does a holistic doctor actually do?

acceptedAnswer.text: A holistic doctor looks at your whole body and life rather than one symptom in isolation. Dr. Nina Ross uses functional medicine to map how your hormones, gut, metabolism, stress, and nutrition connect, runs advanced labs, and builds a personalized plan to treat the root cause.

mainEntity.name: Is holistic and functional medicine evidence based?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Dr. Nina Ross holds a Ph.D. in Functional Medicine and is board certified in holistic health. Care is grounded in advanced lab testing and physiology, read against optimal ranges, not guesswork or generic wellness advice.

mainEntity.name: Why do people search for a Black holistic doctor in Atlanta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many patients want a physician who listens, takes their concerns seriously, and understands their lived experience after years of feeling rushed or dismissed. Dr. Nina Ross offers that unhurried, whole-person care in Atlanta and virtually across Georgia.

mainEntity.name: Do you only see Black patients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dr. Nina Ross welcomes patients of every background. This page simply speaks to those searching for a Black holistic doctor who will hear their whole story.

mainEntity.name: Do you work alongside my regular doctor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Functional medicine care at Nina Ross is provided alongside, not in place of, your primary and specialty care. We coordinate so the whole picture stays connected.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer virtual visits or only in person in Atlanta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. See Dr. Nina Ross in person at our Atlanta clinic, or virtually anywhere in Georgia. Your $99 Symptom Consultation can be booked either way.

sections.label: Hero

headings.text: A Black holistic doctor in Atlanta who hears the whole story.

paragraphs: If you have spent years feeling rushed, brushed off, or told your labs are normal while you still feel unwell, you deserve a doctor who looks closer and listens longer.

I am Dr. Nina Ross, ND PhD. I practice root-cause functional medicine here in Atlanta and virtually across Georgia. That means I read your whole story, your hormones, your gut, your metabolism, the stress you carry, until I find what is really driving how you feel. Then I build the plan around your body and your life, with you in the room the whole way.

imageSlots.alt: Dr. Nina Ross, a Black holistic doctor in Atlanta, with a patient at her functional medicine clinic

sections.label: If this sounds familiar

headings.text: You have been to doctors. You still do not feel heard.

paragraphs: You are not difficult, and you are not imagining it. You have just never been given the time.

sections.label: Meet Dr. Nina

headings.text: The doctor who looks closer and listens longer.

paragraphs: For years I watched people, so many of them women who looked like me, carry symptoms that no one would slow down to explain. So I built the practice I wished they could walk into. One where you are believed first, investigated thoroughly, and treated as a whole person with a life, not a fifteen minute slot.
When someone finally feels seen, the healing has already begun.

sections.label: Why this matters

headings.text: Care from someone who already understands where you are coming from.

paragraphs: When you search for a Black holistic doctor, you are not only looking for credentials. You are looking to be believed without a fight, to be cared for by someone who recognizes your story, and to finally exhale in a doctor’s office. That recognition is where real healing starts.
You should never have to convince your doctor that you know your own body.

imageSlots.alt: Dr. Nina Ross, a Black holistic doctor in Atlanta, sitting with a patient

boldPairs.title: Believed from the first hello
boldPairs.body: After generations of being dismissed and under-treated, your care here starts from trust, never doubt.

boldPairs.title: No translating yourself
boldPairs.body: Your family history, your foods, and your faith all belong in the room and shape the plan we build.

boldPairs.title: Care that fits your life
boldPairs.body: Your plan honors how you actually eat, move, and live, not a template made for someone else.

sections.label: What holistic means

headings.text: Holistic does not mean unscientific. It means whole.

paragraphs: Holistic has been worn down into a spa word. Here it carries its real weight. I treat the whole person with rigorous, lab-driven medicine, reading how every system in your body talks to the others, then following that conversation to the root.
This is medicine that respects both your science and your story.

imageSlots.alt: Advanced functional medicine lab work at Dr. Nina Ross's Atlanta clinic

boldPairs.title: Real labs, read for optimal
boldPairs.body: Advanced panels read against where you actually feel well, not just inside a wide normal range.

boldPairs.title: The whole system, connected
boldPairs.body: Hormones, gut, metabolism, and stress are mapped together so the real driver cannot hide.

boldPairs.title: A plan you help build
boldPairs.body: Care shaped around your body, your culture, and your real life, with you in the room deciding.

headings.text: How we work together: four steps, built around you

paragraphs: An unhurried first visit and advanced labs, so nothing about how you feel gets dismissed.
We map your results together so you finally understand why the symptoms travel as a set.
Nutrition, targeted support, and lifestyle, sequenced to your labs and your real life, not a template.
We adjust as your numbers move, so progress holds and you keep feeling more like yourself.
